question: in which districts did women literacy go down from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: WITH nfhs4 AS (SELECT "District", "State", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS lit4 FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'), nfhs5 AS (SELECT "District", "State", "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" AS lit5 FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5') SELECT n4."District", n4."State", n4."lit4", n5."lit5" FROM nfhs4 AS n4 JOIN nfhs5 AS n5 ON n4."District" = n5."District" AND n4."State" = n5."State" WHERE n4."lit4" > n5."lit5"

    SELECT "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)"
